decisionsTitle: The kits said as runners plus volunteers, the elites on the registrations list and at the start, the site's tick offered once, and «Voluntari» counted like «Înscrieri»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-04,** of «Kituri de pregătit: 178»: «E corect nr. asta? 178? Cu tot cu Ingrid și cu Silviu Stoica? Aș vrea să mă asigur că număr și elitele». Silviu Stoica, registered and marked «Elită» (§897), was among the 178; Ingrid, on the separate elite list (§895) — names, not registrations, in no count by design — was not, though she runs and takes a kit. Reviewing the first answer — two more lines under the kits, «Plus elite din lista separată: N» and «Total de pregătit: N» — he asked for the count said once, as runners plus volunteers; looked for Ingrid on the registrations page and did not find her, the separate list living only in the event's editor; found the tick that stops the site's registrations offered twice on one line; and wrote «si lista de voluntari are un countar total gresit»: the «Voluntari» tab read «2» beside a race with nine volunteers. The same elites stand at the start and wear a bib, which «Locuri» and the bibs' header did not say either.

**Decision — the kits.** The title says the total and its split: «Kituri de pregătit: 188 — 179 de alergători + 9 voluntari», or, with no volunteer ticked «Are kit», «Kituri de pregătit: 179 de alergători». The runners are the registrations holding a place (the special guests among them), the open invitations and the event's separate elite list; a registered runner marked «Elită» is a registration already and is never counted twice. The line under the title splits them — «Alergători: 176 au acum un loc, cu invitați speciali · 2 invitații fără răspuns · 1 elită din lista separată. Lista de așteptare nu intră.» — the elites' part only when there is one, a link to the editor's elite card (`/admin/events/[id]#bib-elite`, which opens the fold). Every count in its own form («1 alergător», «2 alergători», «20 de alergători»; the same for the volunteers, the invitations and the elites), no ICU plural. The volunteers are §904's — ticked «Are kit», the cancelled left out — said in the title now, so §904's line «Plus voluntari cu kit: N» goes, and the first answer's two lines with it. `countKits` and every export are unchanged: the sum is said on the page alone, the elites read from the list the page already reads for its «Elite» fold.

**Decision — «Elite» on the registrations list.** For the event chosen, a closed fold with the medal, its line «N pe lista separată · M înscriși marcați», read-only: the separate list's names, each with its number when one is set, then the registrations marked «Elită» in every state — a cancelled row keeps its mark — each a link to its page with its state chip, never a test row (the club is given no figure with one, `AGENTS.md` §12.6). It ends with the link to the editor's elite card: «Gestionează lista de elite» for the Administrator, who adds and deletes there, «Vezi lista de elite în editor» for the Organizer, who reads it. Both readers assert `canReadRegistrations`; the Tehnic role never reaches the page. Nothing changes from the fold: the separate list changes on the card, the mark on a row's «⋮». No fold while the list spans every event.

**Decision — the people at the start and the bibs.** «Locuri»'s last line adds the separate list to the places' own sum, said only when the list holds a name: «Invitați speciali: 1 (nu ocupă loc). Oameni la start dacă intră toți: 15, inclusiv 2 elite din lista separată.» (`place-outlook.ts#peopleAtStartIfAll`). The places free and the places to add stay the allocator's — an elite name takes none — and a registered runner marked «Elită» is in the places already. The header of «Numere de concurs» says the separate list's bibs beside the registrations' printed ones: «BIB-uri: 5 din 12 printate — doar înscrierile confirmate · + 2 BIB-uri de elită, din lista separată»; the printed figure stays the confirmed registrations' alone, the elite sheet printing from the editor's card. Each count in its own form. The editor's elite card, which said the elites were «în nicio listă sau numărătoare», now says where they are counted: «Pe pagina de înscrieri se numără la kituri, la oamenii de la start și la BIB-uri.» Every other count — `countOccupied`, `countKits`, the summary, the exports, the bib sheet — reads exactly as before.

**Decision — «Pe site acum».** Shut by the tick, the Administrator's line read «înscrierile sunt închise — bifa «Înscrieri publice deschise» e scoasă» beside «Schimbă în editor», above the very tick it named, unticked: one setting offered twice. Now, while that tick is what shuts the door and the Administrator's tick is drawn under the line, the line says only «Pe site acum: înscrierile sunt oprite.» and links to no editor. The tick reads «Înscrierile pe site sunt deschise», its help following the state saved: unticked, «Bifează și apasă «Salvează» ca să le redeschizi.»; ticked, «Debifează și apasă «Salvează» ca să le oprești; tot ce face echipa merge mai departe.». Every other answer — the dates, a full list, «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» — keeps its reason and «Schimbă în editor», where those change; so does the Organizer's line, who is handed no tick and reads «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de un Administrator.». The editor's own tick keeps its name, «Înscrieri publice deschise».

**Decision — the «Voluntari» tab.** Read like «Înscrieri»: the badge is everyone still in at the events ahead — «Înscris» and «Confirmat», never the cancelled, a past event's or a cancelled event's — and, only when some need the organizers, a smaller outlined pill with how many are «de confirmat sau de repartizat»: an offer nobody has answered, or a person given no role (§761), each once. The pill wears the glyph «Dă-i rolul …» wears, is named for a screen reader («3 de confirmat sau de repartizat»), and the tooltip says both figures. One query, memoized a minute like the registrations' badge, for the roles that manage volunteers. Until now the badge was the unanswered offers alone (§839), which a reader took for the total.
changelogLine: - **The kits, the elites, the site's tick and «Voluntari», counted as they read** — «Kituri de pregătit: 188 — 179 de alergători + 9 voluntari», the separate elite list among the runners and linked to its card; an «Elite» fold on the registrations list with the separate list and the registrations marked «Elită»; the same elites among «Locuri»'s people at the start and beside the bibs («+ 2 BIB-uri de elită»); shut by its tick, «Pe site acum» says «înscrierile sunt oprite» above the one tick «Înscrierile pe site sunt deschise»; the «Voluntari» tab counts everyone still in, with a pill for those to confirm or place. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 205. Given the registrations list with one event in scope, then «Kituri de pregătit» says its total as runners plus volunteers — «Kituri de pregătit: N — X alergători + Y voluntari» / “Kits to prepare: N — X runners + Y volunteers”, or «Kituri de pregătit: X alergători» when no volunteer is ticked «Are kit» — the runners being the registrations holding a place (special guests included), the open invitations and the event's separate elite list, a registered runner marked «Elită» counted once; the line under it splits the runners, the elites' part only above nought and a link to `/admin/events/[id]#bib-elite`; every count in its own form («1 alergător», «2 alergători», «20 de alergători»); no «Plus voluntari cu kit» line; `countKits` and every registrations export unchanged (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 105 for the kits, «Locuri»'s people at the start and the bibs' header. Given an event chosen on the registrations list, then a closed fold «Elite» / “Elites”, its line «N pe lista separată · M înscriși marcați», lists read-only the event's separate elite list — each name, its number when set — and its registrations marked «Elită» in every state, never a test row, each a link to the registration's page with its state chip, and links to `/admin/events/[id]#bib-elite` with «Gestionează lista de elite» for an Administrator and «Vezi lista de elite în editor» for the Organizer; both readers refuse a role that may not read the list; no fold while the list spans every event; the separate list's lines count among the kits' runners, «Locuri»'s people at the start and beside the bibs, and in no other count (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given elite lines on the event chosen on the registrations list, then «Locuri»'s last line says «Oameni la start dacă intră toți: N, inclusiv M elite din lista separată.» / “People at the start if everybody comes: N, including M elites on the separate list.” — N the places' own sum plus the M lines, the places free and the places to add unchanged — and the header of «Numere de concurs» adds «+ M BIB-uri de elită, din lista separată» / “+ M elite bibs, from the separate list” beside «BIB-uri: X din Y printate — doar înscrierile confirmate», whose figures stay the confirmed registrations'; with no line, neither is said; each count in its own form («1 elită», «2 elite», «20 de elite»); a registered runner marked «Elită» counted once, as a registration (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 22. Given an internal event shut on the site by «Înscrieri publice deschise» unticked, when an Administrator opens its registrations list, then «Pe site acum» says only «Pe site acum: înscrierile sunt oprite.» / “On the site now: registration is stopped.”, with no «Schimbă în editor», and the tick under it is «Înscrierile pe site sunt deschise» / “Registration on the site is open”, its help «Bifează și apasă «Salvează» ca să le redeschizi.» while unticked and «Debifează și apasă «Salvează» ca să le oprești; tot ce face echipa merge mai departe.» while ticked; every other answer, and the Organizer's line, keep the reason and the editor's link (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 23's tab. Given volunteers at events neither cancelled nor over, then the «Voluntari» tab's figure is everyone «Înscris» or «Confirmat» there, never a cancelled person, a past event's or a cancelled event's, and — only above nought — a smaller pill with the glyph of «Dă-i rolul» counts those with an offer unanswered or no role given, each once, named «N de confirmat sau de repartizat» / “N to confirm or to place”; the tooltip says both figures; no figure when nobody is in; memoized a minute, for the roles that manage volunteers alone (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the kits as runners plus volunteers, an «Elite» fold on the registrations list, the elites at the start and beside the bibs, the site's tick offered once, «Voluntari» counted like «Înscrieri»
